verses.text: In the third month after Israel’s people left Egypt, on that very day, they arrived in the Wilderness of Sinai. 🏜️
They had left Rephidim and reached Sinai’s wilderness. There they camped in front of the mountain. 🏕️
Moses went up to God. Yahweh called to him from the mountain: ‘This is what you must tell Jacob’s family and Israel’s people: 📣
“‘You saw what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you here on eagles’ wings and brought you close to me. 🦅
“‘Now, if you listen carefully to my voice and keep my covenant, you’ll be my treasured people among all nations. The whole earth belongs to me, 🌍
“‘but you will be my kingdom of priests, my holy nation.’ These are the words you must tell Israel’s people.” 🙏
Moses came back, called Israel’s elders together, and repeated everything Yahweh had commanded him. 🗣️
All the people answered together, ‘We’ll do everything Yahweh has said.’ Moses brought their answer back to Yahweh. 🤝
Yahweh told Moses, ‘I’m coming to you in a thick cloud, so the people can hear me speaking with you and trust you always.’ Moses reported the people’s answer to Yahweh. ☁️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to the people. Set them apart today and tomorrow, and have them wash their clothes. 🧼
‘Have them ready for the third day. On that day Yahweh will come down on Mount Sinai where all the people can see. 🏔️
‘Set a boundary around the mountain for the people, and warn them: “Don’t climb the mountain or touch its edge. Anyone who touches it must be put to death. 🚫
“‘No one may touch that person. They must be stoned or shot with arrows—whether person or animal, they must die.” When the trumpet sounds long, the people may come up to the mountain.’ 📯
Moses went down to the people and set them apart for the meeting. They washed their clothes. 🧼
He told the people, ‘Be ready for the third day. Don’t have sex during this time.’ 📅
On the morning of the third day, thunder and lightning struck, a thick cloud covered the mountain, and a very loud trumpet sounded. Everyone in the camp trembled. ⛈️
Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God. They stood at the foot of the mountain. 🏔️
Mount Sinai was covered in smoke because Yahweh came down on it in fire. Smoke rose like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain shook violently. 🔥
As the trumpet kept getting louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice. 📯
Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. He called Moses up, and Moses went up. 🏔️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go down and warn the people not to push through to see me. Many could die. ⚠️
‘The priests who approach Yahweh must set themselves apart too, or Yahweh may break out against them.’ 🙏
Moses said to Yahweh, ‘The people can’t come up Mount Sinai. You already warned us: “Set a boundary around the mountain and make it holy.”’ 🗣️
Yahweh told him, ‘Go down, then come back up with Aaron. But don’t let the priests or people push through to approach me, or I may break out against them.’ 📣
So Moses went down to the people and told them. 🗣️
